title: 8 Reasons a Godly Man Stops Church Hopping
caption:
Three churches in two years. Each one was fine until somebody started to actually know you.

Church hopping feels like being picky. Most of the time it's just a way to never get close enough to be called out. The man of God picks a church, stays, serves, and lets real men learn his name and his sin.

"Planted in the house of the Lord, they flourish." Psalm 92:13

Send this to the brother who keeps leaving.
